finding.title: Fix tutor_pin_reset_screen.dart's Rule-2 barrel bypass and repair the no-op cross-feature-import checker that missed it

evidence.quote: awk -F: '{match($$1, /features\/([^\/]+)\//, a); match($$0, /features\/([^\/]+)\//, b); if(a[1] != b[1]) print}'

finding.why: tutor_pin_reset_screen.dart imports features/account's deep presentation/providers path instead of the account.dart barrel, even though the barrel already exports authRepositoryProvider unhidden — a pure, avoidable Rule-2 violation of one of CLAUDE.md's five 'non-negotiable' layering invariants. It slipped past `make audit` because check 15's awk comparison is a no-op: match($0,...) scans the whole grep line (file-path:linenum:content), so it always matches the FIRST 'features/X/' occurrence, which is in the file-path prefix — identical to match($1,...) — making a[1] and b[1] always equal regardless of what is actually imported. Verified empirically: piping all 1186 non-barrel deep-import candidate lines in lib/features/ through the exact Makefile command yields 0 matches. `make audit` reports 'PASSED — all 22 greps clean' for a check that structurally cannot ever fail, so any current or future cross-feature deep import (this one included) ships silently.
finding.recommendation: Swap the import in tutor_pin_reset_screen.dart to package:learning_tracker/features/account/account.dart. Separately, fix the check-15 awk logic to compare the source file's feature name against the TARGET import's feature name specifically (e.g. match on the import statement field, not $0), then re-run against this known-bad line as a regression fixture to confirm it now fails.
acceptance_criteria: tutor_pin_reset_screen.dart imports the account.dart barrel, not the deep presentation/providers path
make audit check 15 flags the fixed awk logic against a synthetic cross-feature deep-import fixture (proving it can now fail) before being trusted as a gate
grep -rn "package:learning_tracker/features/" lib/features/tutoring --include="*.dart" shows no remaining cross-feature deep imports outside tutoring.dart re-exports
